releases.title: Launch trailer and crisper art
notes: The Sick Of It launch trailer is now on the home page, so you can watch it without leaving the site.
The Overlord, Bork and the fireball art on the home page now look sharper and come alive with animation.

releases.title: Smoother rewinds and sharper aim
notes: Rewinding time now runs smoothly, even deep into a long climb.
The aim laser now follows your real shot path, including upgraded shots.
The mouse cursor is now a crosshair that fits Hell's style.
Restarting a level now really starts it over from the beginning.

releases.title: The climb is open
notes: Hell has 1,000 floors. You have a rewind button. Good luck.
Rewind time when a run goes wrong, which it will.
Install it for offline play, so Hell can come with you.
